subject: Weekly forecast submission — commit lights dry run and evidence grid
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance-ops@acme.com; Tom Keller <tom.keller@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly forecast submission — commit lights dry run and evidence grid

Team —

Quick pulse before the 5pm submission window: I want us to run a short 20m dry run at 11:30 to confirm who presents each account and to lock the commit flags. Goals for the dry run:

- Confirm final commit state for top 12 deals (green/amber/red)
- Validate evidence attachments for each deal and flag any missing items
- Call owner/backup for live submission and who will present to FP&A

Please do the following before 11:30:
1) Update the evidence grid (linked) with filenames for SOC2 artifacts, contract signed dates, and the most recent PO number.
2) Add "commit light" state in the column (i.e., green/amber/red) and a one-line rationale.
3) Flag any deals that need procurement/legal signoff — @Irene I need your list by 10:45.

I've attached the latest deck and seeded the grid with what we have so far. If you can't make the 11:30 dry run, reply with your headcount and who will present.

Meeting: 11:30–11:50 (20m) — Zoom link in calendar invite.

Thanks —
Vanessa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_forecast_deck_v2.pptx
Link: https://drive.google.com/forecast/evidence-grid

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:47:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast submission — commit lights dry run and evidence grid

Thanks Vanessa — on it.

I updated rows 1–8 with latest contract dates and PO numbers and added short rationales for the commit lights. Two quick notes:
- DEAL-112 (BigRetail) moved from amber -> green after legal confirmed the SOW. I attached the signed SOW to the evidence grid (see attachment).
- DEAL-98 (FinTech pilot) still missing SOC2 report; procurement is asking for the December 2025 cert. Irene, can you chase the SOC2 evidence and advise if an interim attestation is acceptable?

I attached the evidence_matrix.xlsx with my updates. I'll present DEAL-112 and DEAL-45 in the dry run — Ben, can you take DEAL-98?

–Marissa
Sr. Account Strategist, Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_matrix.xlsx

From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, finance-ops@acme.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:22:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast submission — commit lights dry run and evidence grid

Vanessa — thanks for the heads up. A couple of clarifications from our side before submission:

1) For deals where the renewal window is Nov 1, we need the invoicing cadence spelled out in the submission (annual vs monthly) — can your sheet include the billing term column?
2) SOC2: we requested a full Type II report; interim attestations are fine but we need a primary contact at Redwood if our procurement team has follow-ups.

I've cc'd finance-ops@acme.com so they can confirm the payment terms we should expect in the submission.

Tom Keller
Director, Vendor Procurement — Acme Corp

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@acme.com>, finance-ops@acme.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast submission — commit lights dry run and evidence grid

Tom — appreciated, and noted. Short answers:

- Billing term: adding a "billing_term" column to the evidence grid now (annual/monthly) — Marissa and Ben, please set this as part of your updates.
- SOC2: Irene, please be the primary contact for Acme procurement for any follow-ups and upload the Type II or interim attestation to the evidence grid. Irene, ping me if you need escalation to security.

Action plan before 11:30 dry run:
- Marissa: finalize your rows and set billing_term entries.
- Ben: take ownership of DEAL-98 follow-up and confirm whether procurement will accept interim attestation; add notes to the grid.
- Irene: upload SOC2 evidence (or note expected delivery date) and be ready to own procurement thread.

I'll run the 20m dry run at 11:30 — calendar invite has the Zoom link and the quick presenter order. If anything blocks the submission (missing PO, missing SOC2, or legal redline), mark the commit light red and add a 1-line mitigation plan.

Thanks all —
Vanessa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
